Questions

Common questions.

Can each branch see only its own data?

Yes. Access is set per branch and role; directors see the whole group.

Can we add branches later?

Yes. A new branch is configured, not rebuilt.

Does it handle different businesses under one owner?

Yes. Millenia runs six different business units on one system.
